name: Hellfire Cloak
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot shoulders Price 24,000 gp; Weight 0.5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This crimson cloak appears to be made of loose knit wool, sparks sometimes dance between its fibers, begging to catch fire.

This cloak confers fire resistance 10 to its wearer. In addition, three times per day the wearer can command the cloak to take the form of a unique large fire elemental as a standard action, appearing in a space adjacent to the wearer of the cloak and acting immediately. This fire elemental uses all the normal statistics of a large fire elemental except as follows; it has a +2 profane bonus to AC, skill checks, attack and damage rolls and has an aura which deals 3d6 damage each round to creatures which start their turn adjacent to the elemental.

This damage is half fire and half unholy. Each creature may attempt a DC 16 reflex save to reduce this damage by half. The cloak maintains this form for one minute or until commanded to return to its original form as a standard action. The elemental recognizes its controller’s enemies and unless otherwise directed will approach and attack the nearest foe each round. While in elemental form, the wearer loses the fire resistance granted by the cloak.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, summon nature’s ally v, protection from energy; Price 12,000 gp
